audit.description: Changed production code in frontmatter/default_handlers.py imports the real tomlkit package and uses tomlkit.loads in TOMLHandler.load plus tomlkit.dumps in TOMLHandler.export. Static and dynamic evidence show no source toml imports from production repository code, and target resolution points to site-packages/tomlkit with no local target provider or shim detected.

frontmatter/default_handlers.py diff changes load to tomlkit.loads(fm, **kwargs).unwrap() and export to tomlkit.dumps(metadata).
Static anti-cheat: frontmatter/default_handlers.py imports_target=true, imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, target_provider_added=false.
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_import from frontmatter/default_handlers.py line 139, target attr access loads at line 312 and dumps at line 317.
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_local_spec_count=0 and tomlkit origin is after_venv_overlay site-packages/tomlkit/__init__.py.
reasons: Production TOML handler meaningfully uses tomlkit APIs.
No changed production code imports or dynamically uses source library toml.
No local fake tomlkit provider/shim evidence; target origin is installed site-packages.
